spanish: Su ofrenda: plato de plata uno, treinta y cien su peso; tazón uno plata, setenta siclo en siclo de la santidad; los dos ellos llenos sólet amasada en el aceite a minjá.

findings.issue: Common noun סלת is left untranslated as sólet; common nouns stay Spanish.
Qal passive participle of mix (בלל) is rendered as kneaded (amasada), a different action.
Common noun מנחה is left untranslated as minjá; common nouns stay Spanish.

notes: Counts, suffixes, silver, shekel, oil, and fullness otherwise match the tokens.
